# Provenance

Sanitized public-source fixtures from `procurement-analysis-discovery/csdl-discovery-20261103/historical-validation-20261103/evidence/fixtures`.

Each year contains twelve contract detail responses, linked report responses and contract lookups, plus their matching search rows. The original collection sampled 17–23 October 2024 and 2025; see the sibling discovery reports for request evidence. Existing `[PRIVATE:...]` pseudonyms are preserved consistently, allowing joins without publishing unnecessary personal/contact details. No authentication material was copied.

These are structural regression samples, not evidence of full-year coverage or a representative population. Synthetic edge cases are constructed in tests, not presented as observed API responses.
